userStories.title: Core abstractions: schema, time helper, state machine, jobs, retry, CLI
acceptanceCriteria: md2short/schema.py JobConfig matches architecture 4.1 (language Literal ko, visual_mode emoticon|photo)
Single ms_to_frames/frames_to_ms helper in Python (md2short/timeutil.py) with tests; no other ms<->frame conversion in Python

job_id matches ^sf_\d{8}_[0-9a-f]{6}$ (tested)
_retry.post_with_retry retries 429/5xx/timeout 3x with 0.5/1.0/2.0s backoff (tested with mocked transport, no real sleep)

uv run md2short --help lists run, status, clean; missing ELEVENLABS_API_KEY -> exit 1 with clear message; --visual-mode photo -> exit 1 with explicit not-implemented message; invalid --lang/--chunk-size -> exit 1

All three tested with mocked httpx (no network)

acceptanceCriteria: caption_plan segments match the Remotion Captions rule (same boundary rules) - tested on fixture words

tts_text normalizes numbers/acronyms for pronunciation while the display script is unchanged
opening produces spoken opening + 2-line visual text and openingDurationMs from words.json
